**Memory 2.0 epic established as an SDD change (#864)**

**What**: Created openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0 — proposal, spec (7 requirements, 15 measurable scenarios), design (lane ruling D1, backend contract D2, dependency graph, stacked-to-main delivery), tasks (one slice per ticket: #820 #862 #863 #805 #738 #247 #361 #461 #712 #714 #638; close #795; exit = brain:change:verify under engram AND plainfiles).

**Why**: #313 declared MEMORY closed as a cluster; the format closed, the pipeline did not. Measured 2026-09-03/05: p50 10.9 h learn-to-main, #820 fired 3 times, 80% of last week's records @legacy, 100% without supersedes.

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/{proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md; GitHub #864 (umbrella), #862 (lane decision), #863 (backend contract); #313 banner amended.

**Learned**: The agnosticism test — does it hold under MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles? — is the acceptance filter for every slice. Stacked-to-main, no tracker branch: a tracker for a memory epic would strand the epic's own records (#795 shape). This record was written record-first via memory:save --issue 864 because mem_save through the MCP cannot carry an issue field (#738).
